subproblem.title: Representation transfer for dilations: λ^{−m}η_*μ with ξ(a + λ·)
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y, let μ be any measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra) and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m) any map. If X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (Bochner integrals, with value 0 for non-integrable integrands), then X'(ω) = ∫ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) d(ofReal(λ^{−m})·η_*μ)(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P), where η_*μ = Measure.map (dilation a λ) μ.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μ) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X' ω = ∫ y, ξ (a + lam • y) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent proof (representation transfer by change of variables for the measurable equivalence η), with the test form ω∘η supplied by the sibling testform_correspondence (a).
Conventions. ℝ^P = Euclid P; η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a), λ > 0. For V ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(V) = TestFormOn V k is the space of C^∞ k-forms ω on ℝ^P (maps to k-covectors) with compact tsupport ω ⊆ V; its elements are determined by their underlying forms. 𝒟_k(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V k. For X, X' ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), X' is a dilation of X when X'(ω) = λ^{−k}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. η_#Y := η_{a,λ#}Y = blowUp Y a λ ∈ 𝒟_k(η(U)) for Y ∈ 𝒟_k(U). Sibling names refer to the children of this decomposition: testform_correspondence = dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr, blowup_structure = dtc_blowUp_algebra, rep_pushforward = dtc_blowUp_imrep, mass_scaling = dtc_blowUp_massOn_image, dilation_blowup = cbr_cidc_dilation_exists_eq_blowUp.
Fix ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P).
1. η is onto ℝ^P: for y ∈ ℝ^P, η(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹a + (λ⁻¹λ)y = y because λ ≠ 0. Hence ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P), i.e. η(ℝ^P) = ℝ^P, so every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) is also an element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) with the same underlying form (tsupport ω ⊆ ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P); SimonGMT testFormOnInclusion), and every element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) is an element of 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with the same underlying form. Let ω₁ ∈ 𝒟^m(η(ℝ^P)) be ω regarded in η(ℝ^P). By testform_correspondence (a) (U = ℝ^P, x = a, n = m) there is ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω₁(η(y)) = ω(η(y)) for all y.
2. By the dilation property for the pair ω, ω' and the representation of X: X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') = λ^{−m}∫ξ(x)(ω'(x)) dμ(x) = λ^{−m}∫ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x), the last step because the integrands agree at every x.
3. η is a homeomorphism of ℝ^P: it is y ↦ λ⁻¹y (a homeomorphism since λ⁻¹ ≠ 0; Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero) followed by the translation z ↦ −λ⁻¹a + z (Homeomorph.addLeft), and this composite is exactly dilation a λ. Hence η is a measurable embedding (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding). For a measurable embedding f, every measure μ and every g : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫g d(f_*μ) = ∫g∘f dμ (Mathlib MeasurableEmbedding.integral_map; no integrability or measurability of g is needed, both sides being 0 in the non-integrable case).
4. Put g(y) := ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)). For every x, a + λη(x) = a + λ(−λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹x) = a − a + x = x (λλ⁻¹ = 1), so g(η(x)) = ξ(x)(ω(η(x))). By step 3, ∫g d(η_*μ) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x).
5. For c ∈ [0,∞] and any measure ν, ∫g d(c·ν) = c.toReal·∫g dν (Mathlib integral_smul_measure). With c = ofReal(λ^{−m}) and λ^{−m} ≥ 0, c.toReal = λ^{−m}. Hence ∫ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) d(ofReal(λ^{−m})·η_*μ)(y) = λ^{−m}∫g d(η_*μ) = λ^{−m}∫ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x) = X'(ω) by steps 2 and 4. ∎
Formalization notes (proved in a scratch build from the exact sibling type): obtain ω' from part (a) of testform_correspondence applied to testFormOnInclusion hsurj m ω; rw [hX ω ω' (fun y => by simpa using hω' y), hrep ω']; let e := (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero λ⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hlam.ne')).trans (Homeomorph.addLeft (-(λ⁻¹ • a))), he : ⇑e = dilation a λ by funext and simp [dilation, dilationCLM], hemb := he ▸ e.measurableEmbedding; rw [integral_smul_measure, hemb.integral_map, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), smul_eq_mul]; congr 1; integral_congr_ae with a + λ • dilation a λ x = x (simp [dilation, dilationCLM, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam.ne']).
proof_key_steps: testform_correspondence (a) supplies ω' = ω∘η ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P), so X'(ω) = λ^{−m}∫ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x).
η is a homeomorphism, hence a measurable embedding; ∫g d(η_*μ) = ∫g∘η dμ for every g (MeasurableEmbedding.integral_map).
With g(y) = ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) and a + λη(x) = x, g∘η = ξ(·)(ω∘η); integral_smul_measure with (ofReal λ^{−m}).toReal = λ^{−m} finishes.
